question: Which model saves the most gasoline? That is to say, have the maximum miles per gallon.
reference_sql: SELECT T1.Model FROM CAR_NAMES AS T1 JOIN CARS_DATA AS T2 ON T1.MakeId  =  T2.Id ORDER BY T2.mpg DESC LIMIT 1;

final.sql:
SELECT cn.Model
FROM cars_data cd
JOIN car_names cn ON cd.Id = cn.MakeId
WHERE CAST(cd.MPG AS REAL) = (SELECT MAX(CAST(MPG AS REAL)) FROM cars_data)
